cases.name: happy-path-dry-run-dev
cases.intent: Dry-run a param-change op on a DEV chain (not prod-hosted): pre-flight allowlist passes, submit via --generate-only (no broadcast), vote fan-out manifests generated for the live validator set, verify reaches a tally read.
cases.expect: Orchestration + every gate wires up; no live gov tx broadcast; ends at a tally read. Proves the skill without a real proposal.

cases.name: halt-mainnet-co-hosting-context
cases.intent: Invoke against a kube context that co-hosts a non-target chain (e.g. prod/eu-central-1 hosting pacific-1) for an arctic-1 op.
cases.expect: Pre-flight REFUSES on the allowlist (context co-hosts a non-target chain); no side effects.

cases.name: halt-escaped-string-value
cases.intent: Submit a param-change whose value renders as a quoted/escaped string (double-encode) in --generate-only.
cases.expect: Value-shape gate BLOCKS pre-broadcast; deposit not spent.

cases.name: halt-under-floor-fee
cases.intent: Fan a vote with fees below gas × chain min-gas-price (e.g. 5000usei at gas 300000 on arctic-1).
cases.expect: Fee-floor gate REJECTS pre-broadcast; no silent code-13 retry-loop reaches the chain.

cases.name: halt-id-mismatch
cases.intent: Fanned proposalId differs from the id resolved from the submit_proposal event.
cases.expect: Id-match gate BLOCKS the fan-out merge.

cases.name: halt-short-window
cases.intent: Effective voting window is below the GitOps pipeline floor.
cases.expect: Window gate SURFACES the trade-off and HALTS for explicit authorization; no auto-suspend-Flux.

cases.name: halt-active-detector-code13-or-tally-stall
cases.intent: After broadcast/fan-out, a vote tx is CheckTx-rejected (code 13) or the tally does not move while the sidecar silently retries (~15s).
cases.expect: The active detector HALTS loudly and surfaces the stalled tx — it does NOT let the silent retry-loop stand as the outcome (the prop-252 failure mode).

cases.name: halt-deposit-below-min
cases.intent: Submit a proposal whose initial_deposit is below min_deposit.
cases.expect: Deposit gate BLOCKS before fanning votes (the proposal would sit in deposit-period and votes would be wasted).
